name: prereg_perbean_v2
status: DRAFT - awaiting user approval; no P1 experiment has been run
requirement: per-bean roast class (light/medium/dark) + count of visible beans; flat/touching/pile scenes; mixed roasts in one image; every bean counts 1; full system < 1 s on Raspberry Pi 5 CPU; classical CV (OpenCV + numpy) + linear classifier only
count_definition: count only beans with >= half of the bean visible; occluded beans cannot be counted -> warning count_visible_only

data.count_test: $ROAST_DATA_DIR/count_test/count_test.csv (not in git): 25 existing trainval images + 15 web slots; split dev 15 / frozen 25 fixed at group level with seed 20261009 before counting (tools/make_count_test.py)
data.rf_boos_gt: rf_boos trainval, YOLO per-bean boxes; mode from segment() with the deployed seg_config
data.single_roast_loso: LOSO folds ontoum224, rf_robusta, rf_boos, agtron (rf_hendi excluded as in B1 R2); trainval only
data.frozen_rules: split=test (manifest) and count_test split=frozen are never used to choose a model, threshold, parameter or epoch; frozen is evaluated once, after the deploy choice, and reported as-is

flat.metric: MAE per image on count_test dev (selection) / frozen (report)

touching.metric: MAPE = mean(|pred - gt| / gt) per image

rf_boos_beans_mode.metric: MAE over all trainval rf_boos images whose segment mode = beans

empty.metric: fraction of rf_hendi empty images with n_beans == 0
empty.null_policy: n_beans null counts as FAIL (counting must always answer) - user to confirm

count.null_policy: for every count metric n_beans = null is scored as pred = 0

single_roast_macro_f1.unit: every detected bean in a single-roast image has true label = image label; per-fold macro-F1 over beans, each bean weighted 1/(beans in its image) so every image counts equally (unweighted also reported)
single_roast_macro_f1.baseline: B1 broadcast: every detected bean gets the B1 image-level label of its image (same beans, same fold model)
single_roast_macro_f1.threshold: for every LOSO fold: F1(candidate) >= F1(B1 broadcast) - 0.02 (paired per fold; all folds must pass)

cross_step.metric: share of beans whose true label is light or dark predicted as the opposite extreme, pooled over folds, image-weighted

mixed_dev.metric: per-image per-class count error = sum_c |pred_c - gt_c| over light/medium/dark, mean over count_test dev images with >= 2 roast classes
mixed_dev.threshold: candidate < B1 broadcast (strictly lower mean); reported with paired per-image differences
mixed_dev.secondary_report_only: rf_boos Mixed video (102 frames, YOLO labels, in-sample for B1)

ml_pi5.metric: bytes->dict p95 on Raspberry Pi 5, JPEG <= 1600 px
sets: worst case: images with ~300 visible beans (real if counted, else synthetic)

e2e.metric: phone select/shoot done -> result shown, FW measures (acceptance A2: 20 images x 2 phones)

time.notebook_proxy: until the Pi is available a notebook p95 is reported but never counts as a pass

deploy_rule: 1. eligible = passes every count gate on count_test dev + rf_boos + empty, every per-bean gate, and the Pi time gate
2. among eligible: lowest pile MAPE on count_test dev; within 0.02 of each other -> lower Pi p95; still tied -> fewer parameters/simpler code
3. then evaluate frozen once and report every gate as pass/fail; no reselection after frozen

4. if no candidate is eligible: deploy the best-on-dev candidate only with the user's explicit decision, keep warnings count_visible_only + bean_count_estimated, and report the failed gates; never describe it as improved
comparison_rules: declare criteria before every run; compare paired per fold (per-bean) or per image (count)
count_test n is small (dev 15) -> report 95% bootstrap CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261009) for every count metric; a point estimate passing with a CI that crosses the threshold is reported as such
never write 'improved' unless the predeclared gate is passed
known_constraints_found_before_run: bean_backend max_blobs = 150 < 300-bean worst case -> must be raised or counting returns null on large piles
bean_backend budget_ms = 100 drops per-bean results on time (measured on notebook) -> results depend on machine load; a Pi will drop more
count_test touching images from existing data are all in frozen (one rf_boos video) -> dev touching comes only from web slots
all existing count_test images are from trainval sources used to train B1 -> per-class counts on them are in-sample for B1
